design: 4 factor cells x 2 pre-registered velocities x 10 independent seed/offset replicates = 80 new impacts

primary_endpoint.definition: At the terminal snapshot after the pre-registered approach run plus 5.0 ps NVE recovery, count original projectile atoms (LAMMPS type 4) with z <= -500 Angstrom and divide by the initial projectile atom count.
primary_endpoint.event_definition: A binary event is recorded only when the terminal projectile-origin downstream mass fraction is greater than or equal to 0.50.
primary_endpoint.name: terminal_projectile_origin_downstream_mass_fraction
primary_endpoint.prohibited_name: Do not call this conventional ballistic V50 or an intact-projectile perforation threshold.
primary_endpoint.reporting_name: V_T,50: velocity at which the probability of the pre-registered >=50% projectile-origin downstream mass-transmission event is 0.5.

protocol.purpose: Confirmatory, origin-labelled projectile mass-transmission threshold experiment after the P2-A intact-body separation endpoint became non-identifiable under fragmentation.
